milk.about: Fresh toned milk from local dairies, pasteurised and packed the same morning.
milk.goodFor: Tea, coffee, curd and daily drinking
milk.tip: Skip the sugar: a pinch of cardamom adds flavour.

curd.about: Thick, creamy curd set fresh every day.
curd.ingredients: Pasteurised toned milk, live curd culture
curd.goodFor: Raita, lassi, buttermilk and with meals
curd.tip: Plain curd goes with almost any meal, with no sugar needed.

paneer.about: Soft paneer made from fresh milk, cut and packed by the dairy.
paneer.tip: Grilling or a light sauté needs very little oil.

eggs.about: Farm eggs, sorted by size and checked for cracks.
eggs.goodFor: Boiled eggs, omelettes, curries and baking
eggs.tip: Boiling or poaching needs no oil at all.

tomato.about: Ripe red tomatoes from farms around Roha, sorted by hand.
tomato.tip: Use ripe ones raw in salads, or cook them down for a smooth gravy.

potato.about: Firm, clean potatoes, good for everyday cooking.
potato.tip: Boiling or baking keeps a dish lighter than frying.

carrot.about: Crisp, sweet carrots, washed and sorted.
carrot.tip: Eat it raw as a snack, or grate it into rotis and rice.

brinjal.about: Tender brinjals with smooth skin, picked fresh.
brinjal.tip: Roast it whole for bharta with very little oil.

banana.about: Ripe yellow bananas, sold by the dozen.
banana.tip: A ripe banana is a snack that needs no preparation.

apple.about: Crisp, juicy apples, sold in a pack of four.
apple.tip: Wash well and eat it with the skin on.

orange.about: Sweet, juicy oranges with thin skin.
orange.tip: Eating the whole fruit gives more fibre than juice.

grapes.about: Seedless green grapes, washed and packed.
grapes.tip: Wash well and chill for a quick snack.

atta.about: Whole wheat atta, stone-ground for soft rotis.
atta.tip: Knead with warm water and rest the dough for softer rotis.

rice.about: Long-grain rice that cooks up fluffy.
rice.tip: Rinse until the water runs clear for fluffier rice.

oil.about: Refined sunflower oil, light on the stomach.
oil.tip: Measure with a spoon instead of pouring, to use less.

sugar.about: Fine white sugar, clean and free-flowing.
sugar.tip: Add it at the end, a little at a time, to taste.

biscuits.about: Crisp tea biscuits, a daily favourite.
biscuits.ingredients: Wheat flour, sugar, edible vegetable oil, milk solids, salt
biscuits.tip: Enjoy a few with your tea instead of the whole pack.

chips.tip: Share a small bowl instead of eating from the pack.

popcorn.about: Ready-to-eat popcorn with a buttery taste.
popcorn.ingredients: Corn, edible vegetable oil, salt, butter flavour
popcorn.tip: Plain popcorn is lighter than the buttery kind: add spices instead.

chocolate.ingredients: Sugar, cocoa butter, milk solids, cocoa mass
chocolate.tip: A small piece goes a long way.

storage.vegetables: Store in a cool, dry place
storage.fruits: Store in a cool place; refrigerate once ripe
storage.staples: Store in an airtight container, away from moisture
storage.snacks: Keep in a cool, dry place; close the pack after opening
